name: legacy-equations
description: The balanced design with every switchable equation set back to the 2026-09-24 explorer's version: fixed tileN=64 tiling, fill/drain per tile, tile-level L1 feed, per-op spill proxy instead of residency, no fusion, serial op sum, uniform 8-bit weights (its W8/A16 mode). Used for ablation and for comparison with that model; it is not exactly equal to it (the KV footprint, recurrence and cross-unit terms differ, see docs/EQUATIONS.md).
